title: Checking the Time for a Lesson
situation: A student checks the clock and confirms the exact time of an English lesson.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa eegaya saacadda oo xaqiijinaya waqtiga saxda ah ee casharka Ingiriisiga.
key_phrases: What time is it?
The clock says half past nine.
My appointment is at quarter to ten.
Is that on the schedule?
I am still learning telling time.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: What time is it?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: The clock says half past nine.
dialogue.somali: Saacaddu waxay leedahay sagaal iyo bar.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: My appointment is at quarter to ten.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Yes, you have time.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Is that on the schedule?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Yes, the schedule says ten o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I am still learning telling time.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: You said the time correctly.
dialogue.somali: Waqtiga si sax ah ayaad u sheegtay.

title: Choosing a Day for a Visit
situation: Two friends choose a day for a short visit and avoid a busy weekday.
somali_situation: Laba saaxiib ayaa dooranaya maalin ay booqasho gaaban sameeyaan waxayna ka fogaanayaan maalin shaqo oo mashquul ah.
key_phrases: Which day is good for you?
Monday is too busy for me.
Can we meet on Friday?
The weekend is better.
Tomorrow is only a weekday.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Which day is good for you?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Monday is too busy for me.
dialogue.somali: Isniintu aad bay iigu mashquul badan tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Can we meet on Friday?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Friday evening may work.
dialogue.somali: Fiidnimada Jimcaha way suurtagal noqon kartaa.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: The weekend is better.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Yes, Saturday is calm.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Tomorrow is only a weekday.
dialogue.somali: Berri waa maalin shaqo oo keliya.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Then Saturday is best.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Good. I will come after lunch.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Qadada ka dib ayaan imanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Weekends are good days for visits.
dialogue.somali: Dhammaadka toddobaadku waa maalmo fiican oo booqasho ah.

title: Choosing a Month to Travel
situation: A traveler and an agent compare months and choose a better month for a family trip.
somali_situation: Socdaale iyo wakiil safar ayaa isbarbar dhigaya bilo waxayna dooranayaan bil ka fiican safar qoys.
key_phrases: Which month is cheaper for travel?
January is busy because of the holiday.
April is in a quieter season.
August is too hot for my children.
Let us choose April.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Which month is cheaper for travel?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: January is busy because of the holiday.
dialogue.somali: Janaayo way mashquul badan tahay fasaxa awgiis.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: What about April?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: April is in a quieter season.
dialogue.somali: Abriil waxay ku jirtaa xilli ka deggan.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Do many people travel in August?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: Yes, many families travel in August.
dialogue.somali: Haa, qoysas badan ayaa safra Agoosto.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: August is too hot for my children.
dialogue.somali: Agoosto carruurtayda aad bay ugu kulushahay.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: Then April may be better.
dialogue.somali: Markaa Abriil ayaa ka fiicnaan karta.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Are the hotels open in that month?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: Yes, most hotels are open all year.
dialogue.somali: Haa, hoteellada badankoodu sannadka oo dhan way furan yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Let us choose April.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: Good choice. I will check flights for those months.
dialogue.somali: Doorasho fiican. Waxaan hubinayaa duulimaadyada bilahaas.

title: Rescheduling a Doctor's Appointment
somali_title: Ballan dhakhtar oo dib loo dhigay
situation: A patient calls a clinic to move an appointment from the morning to a later time and confirms the new slot.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa wacaya xarun caafimaad si uu ballan subaxnimo uga wareejiyo waqti dambe, wuxuuna xaqiijinayaa booska cusub.
key_phrases: I need to reschedule my appointment.
Do you have an available slot this afternoon?
Let me check the doctor's calendar.
Please send me a confirmation.
Your appointment has been moved.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Good morning. I need to reschedule my appointment.
dialogue.somali: Subax wanaagsan. Waxaan u baahanahay inaan dib u dhigo ballantayda.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I can help with that. What name is the appointment under?
dialogue.somali: Waan kaa caawin karaa. Ballantu magacee bay ku qoran tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: It is under Ahmed Ali.
dialogue.somali: Waxay ku qoran tahay Axmed Cali.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I see two appointments for you this month.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan kuu arkaa laba ballamood bishan.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: I mean the appointment for today at ten.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan ula jeedaa ballanta maanta tobanka ah.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Let me check the doctor's calendar.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Do you have an available slot this afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: There is an available slot at three fifteen.
dialogue.somali: Waxaa jira boos bannaan saddex iyo rubuc.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: That works better than the morning.
dialogue.somali: Taasi subaxda way ka fiican tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I will move it to three fifteen.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u wareejinayaa saddex iyo rubuc.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Please send me a confirmation.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I will send the confirmation by text.
dialogue.somali: Xaqiijinta waxaan kuugu soo dirayaa farriin.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Should I arrive early?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Please arrive ten minutes early.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan imow toban daqiiqo ka hor.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Thank you for changing it.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad beddeshay.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Your appointment has been moved.

title: Checking Opening Hours
situation: A customer asks when a shop opens and closes and learns that service stops before closing time.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa weydiinaya goorta dukaanku furmo oo xirmo, wuxuuna ogaanayaa in adeeggu istaago ka hor waqtiga xiritaanka.
key_phrases: What are your opening hours?
We open at nine in the morning.
We close at six in the evening.
Service stops at five thirty.
I will come before five.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What are your opening hours?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Worker
dialogue.english: We open at nine in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What time do you close?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Worker
dialogue.english: We close at six in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I get service at five forty?
dialogue.somali: Shan iyo afartan adeeg ma heli karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Worker
dialogue.english: Service stops at five thirty.
dialogue.somali: Adeeggu wuxuu istaagaa shan iyo bar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I will come before five.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Worker
dialogue.english: That is a good time.

title: Scheduling a Repair Visit
situation: A tenant schedules a repair visit and chooses a time window that fits a workday.
somali_situation: Kirayste ayaa jadwalaynaya booqasho dayactir wuxuuna dooranayaa waqti ku habboon maalinta shaqada.
key_phrases: I need to schedule a repair.
Are you available in the morning?
The afternoon time window is better.
Can you confirm the visit?
The scheduling is complete.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: I need to schedule a repair.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan jadwaleeyo dayactir.

dialogue.speaker: Repair Office
dialogue.english: Are you available in the morning?

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: No, I work in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: Repair Office
dialogue.english: We have a time window from two to four.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan haynaa waqti u dhexeeya laba ilaa afar.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: The afternoon time window is better.

dialogue.speaker: Repair Office
dialogue.english: Good. I can schedule it for tomorrow afternoon.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Berri galab ayaan u jadwalayn karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Can you confirm the visit?

dialogue.speaker: Repair Office
dialogue.english: Yes, I will confirm it by text.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Thank you. I will be home.

dialogue.speaker: Repair Office
dialogue.english: The scheduling is complete.

title: Calling Because You Are Late
somali_title: Wicitaan sababtoo ah waad soo daahaysaa
situation: A customer calls ahead because a bus delay will make them late for an appointment.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa hore u wacaya sababtoo ah dib-u-dhac bas ayaa ka dhigi doona inuu ka daaho ballan.
key_phrases: I am calling because I am late.
There is a delay on the bus route.
How late will you arrive?
Can the doctor wait ten minutes?
Thank you for calling ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hello. I am calling because I am late.
dialogue.somali: Hallow. Waxaan wacayaa sababtoo ah waan soo daahayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Thank you for calling ahead.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad hore u wacday.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: There is a delay on the bus route.
dialogue.somali: Waddada basku dib-u-dhac baa ka jira.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Is it because of traffic?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, traffic is moving slowly.
dialogue.somali: Haa, taraafikadu si tartiib ah bay u socotaa.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: How late will you arrive?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I will arrive about ten minutes late.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan imanayaa qiyaastii toban daqiiqo anigoo daahay.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Your appointment is still okay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can the doctor wait ten minutes?
dialogue.somali: Dhakhtarku toban daqiiqo ma sugi karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Yes, but please arrive as soon as you can.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin fadlan sida ugu dhakhsaha badan u imow.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I understand. I am sorry for being late.
dialogue.somali: Waan fahmay. Waan ka xumahay soo daahitaanka.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: That is all right. We will wait.

title: Talking About How Often
somali_title: Inta jeer ee wax la sameeyo oo laga hadlayo
situation: A patient explains how often symptoms happen and agrees on a simple daily routine.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa sharxaya inta jeer ee calaamado dhacaan wuxuuna oggolaanayaa nidaam maalinle ah oo fudud.
key_phrases: How often does the pain come back?
It happens twice a week.
I rarely feel it in the morning.
A daily routine may help.
We will review the frequency next week.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: How often does the pain come back?
dialogue.somali: Xanuunku inta jeer ayuu soo noqdaa?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: It happens twice a week.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Is the frequency the same every week?
dialogue.somali: Inta jeer ma isku mid bay tahay toddobaad kasta?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: No, some weeks are better.
dialogue.somali: Maya, toddobaadyada qaar way ka fiican yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Do you feel it daily?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: No, I rarely feel it in the morning.
dialogue.somali: Maya, subaxdii dhif ayaan u dareemaa.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Does it happen after heavy meals?
dialogue.somali: Ma dhacdaa cunto culus ka dib?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Often, yes. Dinner is the worst time.
dialogue.somali: Badanaa, haa. Cashadu waa waqtiga ugu xun.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: A daily routine may help.
dialogue.somali: Nidaam maalinle ah ayaa laga yaabaa inuu caawiyo.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Should I write it down weekly?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Yes, write the day and time.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: That will make the pattern clear.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: We will review the frequency next week.
dialogue.somali: Toddobaadka dambe ayaan dib u eegi doonnaa inta jeer.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Thank you. I can do that.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Bring the notes to your next visit.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: I will bring them.

title: Asking About a Holiday
situation: A customer asks whether a shop is open during a holiday and chooses to come after the holiday.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa weydiinaya haddii dukaanku furan yahay xilliga fasaxa wuxuuna dooranayaa inuu yimaado fasaxa ka dib.
key_phrases: Are you open today?
Today is a holiday.
We are closed tomorrow.
Do holidays change your hours?
I will come after the holiday.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Are you open today?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Worker
dialogue.english: Yes, but today is a holiday.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do holidays change your hours?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Worker
dialogue.english: Yes, we close early on holidays.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fasaxyada goor hore ayaan xirmaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Are you open tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Worker
dialogue.english: No, we are closed tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I will come after the holiday.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Worker
dialogue.english: That is better. We open normally then.
dialogue.somali: Taasi way fiican tahay. Markaas si caadi ah ayaan u furnaa.
